verdict.rationale: The docs describe a CLI (wally/rcli) and OpenAI-compatible endpoint for local/dev use, but there is no documentation of headless execution, CI integration, non-interactive flags, or automation pipelines. Community reports actually describe install failures and segfaults with the CLI, which further undercuts any implicit claim of automatable/headless reliability. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless docs, non-interactive mode, automation examples, evidence of stable non-GUI operation.
